title: Variable Information Data Segment
applicability: Conditionally included in Data Section 3 whenever a Segment 100 transaction/card/merchant context requires a Variable Information Table.
scopeNote: Core-structure baseline: Segment Type/Length only. Table-ID-specific rules are already covered in the Appendix I evidence file; not duplicated here.

businessRequirements.title: Segment Type field in the Variable Information Data Segment has fixed value 111.
Segment Length identifies the Variable Information Data Segment's total length including Segment Type and Field Separators.
The Variable Information Data Segment has a maximum length of 999 alphanumeric characters.
Field Separators do not appear between elements within a Variable Information Section repetition or between repetitions; a single Field Separator follows the final repetition.

testCases.positive: No separators within/between table repetitions; one trailing separator after the final repetition

testDataStatus: Segment Type/trigger checks are already covered via Appendix I (BR-SEG100-APPI-VARIABLE-TRIGGER); this file adds only the segment-envelope rules not already captured there.
remaining: See appendix-i-segment-100-coverage.json for Table-ID-specific Variable Information rules; this file intentionally does not duplicate them.
